title: Management: Application of rumen magnets / 8. PARASITES
text:

facts: A key management practice for preventing hardware disease (traumatic reticuloperitonitis) is the application of rumen magnets.
Rumen magnets attract and hold ingested ferromagnetic objects such as wire and nails to prevent them from penetrating the reticulum wall.
Parasites in dairy cattle are divided into two main categories: Endoparasites and Ectoparasites.
Endoparasites listed in cattle include Roundworms, Tapeworms, and protozoa.
Ectoparasites listed in cattle include Ticks.
